_comment: Lab 4 — dashboard as code, provider-neutral form. The one actually deployed is infra/gcp/dashboard.json (Cloud Monitoring), created by infra/gcp/lab4-monitoring.sh; each panel here names the Cloud Monitoring metric it maps to. Committing the dashboard is better than clicking one together, and is noted favourably.
title: ITCS355 — Prediction service

panels.title: Error rate by class
panels._note: 4xx and 5xx must be split. 4xx is usually a caller problem; 5xx is yours.
panels.gcp: request_count by response_code_class 4xx and 5xx, each divided by all requests

panels.title: Latency p50 / p95 / p99
panels._note: If p99 is far above p95 in a repeating pattern, suspect cold start or a per-request model load.
panels.gcp: run.googleapis.com/request_latencies, REDUCE_PERCENTILE_50/95/99; SLO line at 100 ms (endpoint)

panels.title: Feature drift (PSI, rolling 30-min window)
panels._note: monitoring/drift.py --endpoint, every 5 min (Cloud Scheduler -> Cloud Run job): PSI of each feature over the last 30 min of scored inputs vs the training data, written with adapter.emit_metric. Alert at 0.05; why 0.05 is in the README.
panels.gcp: custom.googleapis.com/itcs355/drift/psi, label feature; companions drift/ks, drift/mean, drift/window_rows

panels.title: Model version in production
panels._note: During a canary you should see two. If you see two when you are not deploying, something is wrong.
